# aad-token-provider API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Native token-provider acquisition does not request tokens automatically.

## SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo

Native SPFx token provider with asynchronous initialization state; acquisition failures remain distinct from token-request failures.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Examples

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo, useSPFxAadTokenProvider } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function Example() {
  const info: SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo = useSPFxAadTokenProvider();
  console.log(info.isReady, info.initError);
  return <span>{info.isReady ? 'Ready' : 'Unavailable'}</span>;
}
```

### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo.initError` | `Error \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Error that occurred during token provider initialization.<br>If set, the token provider will remain undefined. |
| `SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo.isInitializing` | `boolean` | Required, readonly | — | True while the AAD token provider is being initialized.<br>Use this to show a loading indicator during startup. |
| `SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo.isReady` | `boolean` | Required, readonly | — | Computed state: true when token provider is ready for use.<br>Equivalent to: tokenProvider !== undefined && !isInitializing && !initError |
| `SPFxAadTokenProviderInfo.tokenProvider` | `AadTokenProvider \| undefined` | Required, readonly | — | Native AadTokenProvider from SPFx.<br>Provides access tokens for Azure AD-secured resources.<br>Will be undefined until initialization completes. |

## useSPFxAadTokenProvider

Acquires the SPFx AadTokenProvider asynchronously from ServiceScope. Factory consumption and provider acquisition failures are captured in initError. No token is acquired by this hook itself.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import { useSPFxAadTokenProvider } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { useSPFxAadTokenProvider } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/hooks';
```

### Use when

- an integration needs the native token provider rather than an HTTP wrapper.

### Throws

- When called outside an SPFx provider.

### Examples (2)

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { useSPFxAadTokenProvider } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function TokenStatus() {
  const { isReady, initError } = useSPFxAadTokenProvider();
  return <span>{initError?.message ?? (isReady ? 'Ready' : 'Initializing')}</span>;
}
```

#### Inspect delegated scopes from a manual token

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import {
  decodeSPFxJwtPayload,
  useSPFxAadTokenProvider,
} from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

function TokenProbe() {
  const { tokenProvider, isReady, isInitializing, initError } = useSPFxAadTokenProvider();
  const [scopeText, setScopeText] = React.useState<string>('');
  const [failure, setFailure] = React.useState<string>();

  const inspectGraphToken = async () => {
    if (!tokenProvider) {
      return;
    }

    setFailure(undefined);
    try {
      const token = await tokenProvider.getToken('https://graph.microsoft.com');
      const payload = decodeSPFxJwtPayload(token);
      setScopeText(payload?.scp || '');
    } catch (failure) {
      setFailure(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : String(failure));
    }
  };

  if (isInitializing) return <p role="status">Preparing token provider...</p>;
  if (initError) return <p role="alert">{initError.message}</p>;

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={inspectGraphToken} disabled={!isReady}>
        Inspect Graph scopes
      </button>
      {failure && <p role="alert">{failure}</p>}
      <pre>{scopeText}</pre>
    </>
  );
}
```
